[FACT] User has been driving a 2018 Honda Civic Si for about a year.

[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on upgrading brake pads for track driving.

[EVENT] User is planning to participate in another track day next weekend at a new track.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upgrading brake pads is a great idea to improve performance and safety on the track.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should identify the cause of brake fade before upgrading.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brake pad materials include Organic (Non-Metallic), Semi-Metallic, and Full-Metallic.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested looking for high-temperature ratings for track brake pads (e.g., 500°F to 600°F).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Different pad compounds include Street compounds (softer, quieter) and Track compounds (more aggressive).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brands for track brake pads include Brembo, Ferodo, Hawk Performance, Pagid, and Performance Friction.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular brake pad options for track use: Brembo HP2000 or GT, Ferodo DS2500 or DS3000, Hawk Performance HP Plus or DTC-60, Pagid RST5 or RS29.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to perform a proper bedding-in process when installing new brake pads.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested consulting with a professional mechanic or track-day prep specialist if the user is new to track driving.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended specific brake pad options for the 2018 Honda Civic Si: Hawk Performance HP Plus, Ferodo DS2500, and Brembo HP2000.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to ensure rotor compatibility with new brake pads.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested upgrading brake fluid to a high-temperature fluid like Motul RBF 660 or Castrol SRF for the upcoming track day.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained the benefits of high-temperature brake fluid, including higher boiling point and better viscosity.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended flushing and bleeding the brake system after installing new fluid.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged user to learn from more experienced drivers to improve their driving skills.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested being humble and open-minded when learning from others.
